identity.title: [v0.92.1][docs] Reconcile onboarding workflow and repository authority with Gate 10D2

values.task_boundary: Bounded docs-truth repair for onboarding and nearby workflow guidance.
deliverables: Focused validation evidence for retired-route removal and current-authority presence
Truthful SOR describing actual docs changes and validation
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: `docs/onboarding.md` no longer presents `adl_pr_cycle`, `pr ready`, or `pr run` as the current default lifecycle route.
AC-2: `docs/onboarding.md` names Gate 10D2 typed C-SDLC v2 as current authority and points current lifecycle work at `.adl/bin/csdlc-v2/` plus `csdlc-v2/operator/skills/`.

AC-3: Documentation distinguishes canonical `agent-logic/agent-design-language` from legacy `danielbaustin/agent-design-language` and explains the latter is historical provenance unless a bounded legacy task explicitly says otherwise.

AC-4: Startup/root checkout guidance remains aligned with `AGENTS.md`: root should stay on clean `main`, issue work happens in a bound worktree, and new ADL issue worktrees belong under `/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees`.
AC-5: Docs avoid claiming that an initialized issue, green CI, or publication alone proves terminal closeout; they preserve review, publication, finish, and cleanup boundaries.
AC-6: Focused validation checks edited docs for retired route strings and confirms current typed v2 authority references are present.
non_goals: Implementing the documentation fix during bootstrap
Changing lifecycle binaries or skill contracts
Changing GitHub remotes, labels, milestones, PR state, or release state
Reviving v1 wrappers or the compatibility `adl_pr_cycle` route
